run_query_db_print: run the query_db CLI with the print action to output selected dataset entries to stdout
run_query_db_show: run the query_db CLI with the show action to visualize DensePose annotations on images
run_register_action: run the register_action decorator to register a new action class in the action registry
review_EntrywiseAction: review the EntrywiseAction class that provides dataset entry selection and iteration logic
review_ShowAction_visualizers: review the ShowAction VISUALIZERS dict that maps visualization names to DensePose visualizer instances
